document.abstract: The Society for Information Display (SID) was founded in 1962 as a professional society that promotes, educates, and facilitates information display related to science and technology, business, and standards. The society is international in nature, and the headquarters are based in San Jose, CA. Currently, the society has chapters and activities throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe. The membership of the society is primarily composed of display professionals, including engineers, scientists, business executives, and entrepreneurs. A large fraction of the membership is made of industry professionals and academicians. Membership of SID is open to all individuals interested in information display without regard to race, color, age, religion, gender, or nationality. Additionally, there are various membership categories for individual members, including senior member grade, fellow grade, and sustaining memberships for corporations.
